project.name: Xerces2-J
project.description: Xerces2 provides high performance, fully compliant XML parsers in the Apache Xerces family. This new version of Xerces continues to build upon the Xerces Native Interface (XNI), a complete framework for building parser components and configurations that is extremely modular and easy to program.

properties.xerces.name: Xerces-J
properties.impl.name: ${xerces.name} ${project.version}
properties.copyright: Copyright © ${year} The Apache Software Foundation. All Rights Reserved.
properties.default.parser.config.name: XIncludeAwareParserConfiguration

javac.excludes: org/xml/sax/** javax/xml/** org/w3c/dom/* org/w3c/dom/events/** org/w3c/dom/html/** org/w3c/dom/ranges/** org/w3c/dom/traversal/** org/w3c/dom/xpath/**

jar.includes: org/apache/**, META-INF/**, org/w3c/dom/ls/**, org/w3c/dom/DOMError.class, org/w3c/dom/DOMErrorHandler.class, org/w3c/dom/DOMImplementationSource.class, org/w3c/dom/DOMImplementationRegistry.class, org/w3c/dom/DOMLocator.class, org/w3c/dom/UserDataHandler.class
